questionAudits.original: I arranged for a mechanic to replace my worn brake cables yesterday.
questionAudits.target: I ____ yesterday.
accepted: had my worn brake cables replaced
completedSentences: I had my worn brake cables replaced yesterday.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: had my worn brake cables repair
questionAudits.rationale: have something done表示安排他人完成维修；此处保留过去时和被更换的刹车线。repair缺少被动分词形式，不能接在该结构中。

questionAudits.original: You must not ride this bicycle under any circumstances.
questionAudits.target: Under ____ this bicycle.
completedSentences: Under no circumstances must you ride this bicycle.
questionAudits.rationale: 否定短语under no circumstances前置时，后面使用must you ride的部分倒装；保持绝对禁止骑行的含义，不能变成肯定的any circumstances。

questionAudits.original: We have not received the replacement axle yet.
questionAudits.target: We ____ the replacement axle.
completedSentences: We have yet to receive the replacement axle.
questionAudits.rationale: have yet to do表示到目前仍未完成，保留尚未收到车轴的含义。to后应接动词原形receive；received of不是可接受的补语结构。

questionAudits.original: The mechanic deliberately checks the serial number before every repair.
questionAudits.target: The mechanic ____ the serial number before every repair.
completedSentences: The mechanic makes a point of checking the serial number before every repair.
questionAudits.rationale: make a point of doing强调有意识地坚持做某事，对应每次维修前刻意核对序列号。of后接动名词，to checking在此结构中错误。

questionAudits.original: There is no point in repairing this badly bent rim.
questionAudits.target: This badly bent rim ____.
completedSentences: This badly bent rim is not worth repairing.
This badly bent rim isn't worth repairing.
questionAudits.rationale: not worth doing表示不值得进行这项修理，与there is no point in repairing对应。worth后接动名词repairing，不能接to repair。

questionAudits.original: The locked tool cabinet stopped the children from reaching the solvent.
questionAudits.target: The locked tool cabinet ____ the solvent.
completedSentences: The locked tool cabinet prevented the children from reaching the solvent.
questionAudits.rationale: prevent somebody from doing表示阻止某人接触溶剂，与stopped的过去事件一致。必须保留from；to reaching破坏该动词的补语结构。

questionAudits.original: The seats sold so quickly that extra screenings were arranged.
questionAudits.target: So ____ that extra screenings were arranged.
completedSentences: So quickly did the seats sell that extra screenings were arranged.
questionAudits.rationale: So加副词置于句首形成结果结构时，使用did the seats sell倒装，并以动词原形sell接在did后。原句的售票速度和加场结果均保留。

questionAudits.original: Without the equipment that the volunteers lent us, the screening would have been impossible.
questionAudits.target: ____ the volunteers' equipment, the screening would have been impossible.
completedSentences: had it not been for the volunteers' equipment, the screening would have been impossible.
questionAudits.rationale: Had it not been for相当于If it had not been for，表达过去的反事实条件：若没有志愿者设备就无法放映。if it not been for缺少所需助动词。

questionAudits.original: The manager assumes without questioning it that all viewers will read the warnings.
questionAudits.target: The manager ____ all viewers will read the warnings.
completedSentences: The manager takes it for granted that all viewers will read the warnings.
questionAudits.rationale: take it for granted that表示把从句内容视为理所当然，保留经理未经质疑就作出假定的含义。形式宾语it必须位于takes之后。

questionAudits.original: This film is much longer than any other film the director has made.
questionAudits.target: This is ____ the director has ever made.
completedSentences: This is by far the longest film the director has ever made.
questionAudits.rationale: by far加强最高级，the longest film对应比导演其他所有影片都长得多。more与longest叠加不成立，也不能用比较级替代最高级范围。

questionAudits.original: The projector started working again only after a second technician arrived.
questionAudits.target: It ____ arrived that the projector started working again.
accepted: was not until a second technician
completedSentences: It was not until a second technician arrived that the projector started working again.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: was until not a second technician
questionAudits.rationale: It was not until...that是强调时间起点的结构，对应only after第二位技师到场才恢复。not必须紧邻was之后并在until之前。

questionAudits.original: The assistant said that she would prefer not to discuss the ending at that moment.
questionAudits.target: The assistant said, "I ____ ending at the moment."
completedSentences: The assistant said, "I would rather not discuss the ending at the moment."
questionAudits.rationale: would rather not加动词原形，表示当时不愿讨论结局，保留原句的偏好而非改为禁止。discussing不能直接作would rather后的谓语。

questionAudits.original: The team was just about to abandon the search when a whistle sounded.
questionAudits.target: The team ____ abandoning the search when a whistle sounded.
completedSentences: The team was on the verge of abandoning the search when a whistle sounded.
questionAudits.rationale: be on the verge of doing表示即将做某事，保留听见哨声前差一点放弃搜寻的时间关系。固定介词为on，不是in。

questionAudits.original: The locked gate meant that we could not get into the hut.
questionAudits.target: The locked gate meant that we ____ the hut.
completedSentences: The locked gate meant that we could not gain access to the hut.
The locked gate meant that we couldn't gain access to the hut.
questionAudits.rationale: gain access to表示进入或获得通行，could not保留当时无法进入小屋的事实。access在此搭配to，不能用at替代。

questionAudits.original: Only after the last walker had been found did the rescuers leave.
questionAudits.target: The rescuers ____ the last walker had been found.
completedSentences: The rescuers did not leave until the last walker had been found.
The rescuers didn't leave until the last walker had been found.
questionAudits.rationale: not leave until对应直到找到最后一位徒步者才离开。助动词did后必须使用leave原形；left不符合时态结构。

questionAudits.original: The leader was sure that the team had left the radio at the campsite.
questionAudits.target: The leader said, "The team ____ at the campsite."
completedSentences: The leader said, "The team must have left the radio at the campsite."
questionAudits.rationale: must have加过去分词表达对过去事件的确信推断，对应领队确信无线电落在营地。must后接have而非had。

questionAudits.original: Despite the guide's repeated warnings, several walkers took the closed path.
questionAudits.target: Several walkers took the closed path ____ the guide's repeated warnings.
completedSentences: Several walkers took the closed path in spite of the guide's repeated warnings.
questionAudits.rationale: in spite of与despite在这里都表示尽管有反复警告仍走了封闭道路，保留让步关系。固定短语开头为in而非on。

questionAudits.original: The new emergency marker helped explain where the route had changed.
questionAudits.target: The new emergency marker ____ where the route had changed.
completedSentences: The new emergency marker shed light on where the route had changed.
questionAudits.rationale: shed light on在这里表示帮助解释路线改变的位置，保留过去时shed。at不能引出该抽象说明对象，也不能替换on。

questionAudits.original: That concert was the orchestra's first outdoor performance.
questionAudits.target: The orchestra ____ before that concert.
completedSentences: The orchestra had never played outdoors before that concert.
The orchestra had never performed outdoors before that concert.
questionAudits.rationale: 过去的首场户外演出意味着在那场之前从未在户外演奏，应用过去完成时。played与performed都保留该含义；playing不能接在had never后。

questionAudits.original: The conductor does not intend to replace the cellist.
questionAudits.target: The conductor ____ the cellist.
completedSentences: The conductor has no intention of replacing the cellist.
questionAudits.rationale: have no intention of doing对应没有更换大提琴手的打算；of后接replacing。to replacing在这一结构中不合语法。

questionAudits.original: The score was so difficult that we changed the rehearsal plan.
questionAudits.target: It was ____ that we changed the rehearsal plan.
completedSentences: It was such a difficult score that we changed the rehearsal plan.
questionAudits.rationale: such a加形容词和可数名词单数构成结果结构，与so difficult的难度和更改排练计划的结果相同。冠词位置不能放在形容词后。

questionAudits.original: The venue was wrong not to tell us about the scheduled power cut.
questionAudits.target: The venue ____ the scheduled power cut.
completedSentences: The venue should have told us about the scheduled power cut.
questionAudits.rationale: should have told表达过去本该通知但未通知的批评，保留原句对场地方的责任判断。情态动词后不能用had。

questionAudits.original: As soon as the conductor entered, the brass section started tuning.
questionAudits.target: No sooner ____ the brass section started tuning.
completedSentences: No sooner had the conductor entered than the brass section started tuning.
questionAudits.rationale: No sooner前置使用had加主语加过去分词，并用than连接紧接着发生的事件。entered保留入场已经发生，entering不构成过去完成时。

questionAudits.original: You must send the final programme by Friday, whatever happens.
questionAudits.target: The final programme ____ by Friday, whatever happens.
completedSentences: The final programme must be sent without fail by Friday, whatever happens.
questionAudits.rationale: must be sent转换为被动而不改变必须按时发送的要求，without fail强调务必完成。with fail不是该固定表达。

questionAudits.original: I would prefer you not to use that pan.
questionAudits.target: I ____ that pan.
accepted: would rather you did not use
completedSentences: I would rather you did not use that pan.
I would rather you didn't use that pan.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: would rather you not to use
questionAudits.rationale: would rather somebody did not do表达对他人当下行为的偏好，过去式表示虚拟而非过去时间。you not to use不是该结构的正确补语。

questionAudits.original: The instructor insisted that we wash our hands before making the dough.
questionAudits.target: The instructor ____ our hands before making the dough.
completedSentences: The instructor insisted on our washing our hands before making the dough.
The instructor insisted on us washing our hands before making the dough.
questionAudits.rationale: insist on后可用our washing，口语也可用us washing，二者均保留要求我们洗手。insisted for不能引出这里的动名词补语。

questionAudits.original: It is impossible to reproduce this result without a thermometer.
questionAudits.target: Reproducing this result without a thermometer ____.
completedSentences: Reproducing this result without a thermometer is out of the question.
questionAudits.rationale: out of the question在此表示不可能，与缺少温度计就无法复现的条件一致。固定介词of不能替换为from。

questionAudits.original: Nobody took any notice of the alarm until the instructor pointed to it.
questionAudits.target: Nobody ____ the alarm until the instructor pointed to it.
completedSentences: Nobody paid any attention to the alarm until the instructor pointed to it.
questionAudits.rationale: pay attention to对应take notice of，Nobody与any共同保留无人留意警报的否定含义。attention后应接to而非at。

questionAudits.original: The chef checked the ovens as a safety measure before leaving.
questionAudits.target: The chef ____ the ovens before leaving.
completedSentences: The chef took the precaution of checking the ovens before leaving.
questionAudits.rationale: take the precaution of doing表示作为预防措施而检查，与原句安全核查的目的相同。of后接动名词，to checking不成立。

questionAudits.original: This cooling rack is not nearly as stable as the old one.
questionAudits.target: This cooling rack ____ the old one.
accepted: is nowhere near as stable as
is nowhere near so stable as
isn't anywhere near as stable as
completedSentences: This cooling rack is nowhere near as stable as the old one.
This cooling rack is nowhere near so stable as the old one.
This cooling rack isn't anywhere near as stable as the old one.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: is nowhere near as stable than
questionAudits.rationale: nowhere near as或so...as表示远不及，保留新架子稳定性较差的比较方向。结尾必须为as；than不能与这里的同级比较结构搭配。

questionAudits.original: Sarah was not convinced that the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
questionAudits.target: Sarah ____ the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
completedSentences: Sarah was doubtful that the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
Sarah was doubtful whether the neglected plot could ever produce enough vegetables.
questionAudits.rationale: be doubtful that或whether均表达对产量可能性的怀疑，保留不确信的态度。of不能直接放在that从句前形成of that结构。

questionAudits.original: The donation made it possible for us to replace the broken water tank.
questionAudits.target: The donation ____ the broken water tank.
completedSentences: The donation enabled us to replace the broken water tank.
questionAudits.rationale: enable somebody to do表示使我们能够更换水箱，对应made it possible。其补语需要to replace，不能用replacing of。

questionAudits.original: Do not promise to share tools unless you really intend to.
questionAudits.target: Do not ____ unless you really intend to.
accepted: make a commitment to sharing tools
make a commitment to share tools
completedSentences: Do not make a commitment to sharing tools unless you really intend to.
Do not make a commitment to share tools unless you really intend to.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: make a commitment for share tools
questionAudits.rationale: make a commitment可接to sharing tools或to share tools，均表示承诺共享工具。保留unless条件；for share不构成合格补语。

questionAudits.original: I regret not labelling the seeds before putting them away.
questionAudits.target: If only ____ before putting them away!
completedSentences: If only I had labelled the seeds before putting them away!
questionAudits.rationale: If only加过去完成时表达对过去未贴标签的遗憾；had labelled与原句regret not对应。would labelled缺少正确的完成结构。

questionAudits.original: Replacing the broken slabs made the paths safer.
questionAudits.target: Replacing the broken slabs ____.
completedSentences: Replacing the broken slabs resulted in safer paths.
questionAudits.rationale: result in后接结果，safer paths保留铺路板更换后道路更安全的因果方向。result to不是这里的固定搭配。

questionAudits.original: We finished the planting successfully despite the rain.
questionAudits.target: We ____ planting despite the rain.
completedSentences: We succeeded in finishing the planting despite the rain.
questionAudits.rationale: succeed in doing表示成功完成，finishing the planting对应已成功完成种植。in后接动名词，to finishing在该搭配中错误。
